title: Balance transfer timescales
body: Balance transfers usually complete within 3 to 5 working days once the transfer request is accepted. You should keep paying your existing card until the transfer shows as settled.

title: Replacing a lost or stolen card
body: A replacement card is despatched within one working day of the report and typically arrives in 3 to 5 working days. The old card is blocked immediately.

title: Disputing a transaction
body: Transactions can be disputed within 120 days of the transaction date. Provisional credit may be applied while the claim is investigated, and the investigation usually takes up to 45 days.

title: Interest rates and how interest is charged
body: Interest is charged on any balance not cleared in full by the payment due date. Purchases have an interest-free period of up to 56 days when the previous balance was settled in full.

title: Changing your address
body: An address change is applied within one working day. A confirmation letter is sent to both the old and new address as a security measure.

title: Increasing your credit limit
body: Credit limit increase requests are assessed against affordability and account history. A decision is normally provided within 5 working days.

title: Requesting duplicate statements
body: Statements from the last 6 years can be requested. Digital copies are available immediately in online banking and postal copies arrive within 7 working days.

title: Direct debit setup and changes
body: A direct debit takes up to 10 working days to become active. Until then a manual payment should be made to avoid a missed payment.

title: Foreign transaction fees
body: A non-sterling transaction fee of 2.99% applies to purchases made in a foreign currency. Cash withdrawals abroad also carry a cash fee.

title: Closing your account
body: An account can be closed once the balance is cleared. Any pending transactions must settle first, which can take up to 30 days.
